title: GONICUS sells sovereign infrastructure with no sovereign business record on top of it
content:
GONICUS delivers Sovereign Cloud Stack, Proxmox and Kubernetes. All three are infrastructure: they settle where workloads run, who operates them, and under whose jurisdiction the substrate sits. That is a real form of sovereignty and it is the layer the firm sells today.

The research's observation is that nothing in the portfolio supplies a sovereign business record above it. Controlling the substrate does not produce an attributed, replayable account of what an organisation decided — a self-hosted cluster can run an application whose decisions are exactly as unreconstructable as a hosted one's. The two layers are independent, and only one of them is covered.

That makes the fit a portfolio extension rather than a displacement, which is the easiest conversation to have with an infrastructure firm. Powerhouse is the application-layer counterpart to the argument GONICUS already makes to its customers, so the sovereignty case does not need to be established — only carried one layer up.
